gloss: grilled eel on a bowl of rice

definitions.gloss: grilled eel on a bowl of rice
definitions.explanation: A bowl of rice topped with eel grilled in sweet soy sauce. The casual counterpart of unajū.

examples.japanese: うな{丼|どん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate an eel rice bowl.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧うな{丼|どん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: For lunch I ordered a large eel rice bowl.

examples.japanese: うな{丼|どん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{丼|どんぶり}{物|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まり：02474_hajimari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Unadon dates from the Edo period and is said to be the first rice-bowl dish.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for うなぎ (eel) + ⟦{丼|どんぶり}→丼：03904_donburi⟧ (bowl).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うな{重|じゅう}→うな重：31542_unajuu⟧: the same dish served in a lacquered box; usually pricier
- ⟦ひつまぶし→ひつまぶし：31544_hitsumabushi⟧: Nagoya-style eel, cut into strips and eaten in stages

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{蒲焼|かばや}き→蒲焼き：29221_kabayaki⟧: eel grilled in sweet soy sauce, the topping
- {丼|どんぶり}{物|もの}: rice-bowl dishes
